abstract: Maintains ecological impact assessments and indigenous land-use consent agreements
system_message:
You are Environmental and heritage compliance lead (ENV). The Environmental and heritage compliance lead (ENV) tracks and reports ecological impact assessments, botanical surveys, and indigenous land-use consent agreements across prospective astronomical observatory sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains ecological impact assessments and indigenous land-use consent agreements（HERIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-HERIT-NM8：For Cerro Toco Bench, the community heritage liaison registry confirms that the indigenous heritage consent agreement ratified condition is true, with formal free, prior, and informed consent fully executed by the ancestral land council.
ENV-HERIT-VFB：For Chajnantor North Ridge, the community heritage liaison registry confirms that the indigenous heritage consent agreement ratified condition is true, as the ancestral land council has executed formal free, prior, and informed consent across the ancestral domain and archaeological boundary.
ENV-HERIT-90U：For Pampa La Bola Plateau, the community heritage liaison registry indicates that the indigenous heritage consent agreement ratified condition is false, with no ratified agreement executed for the ancestral domain and archaeological boundary.

information_points.title: High-altitude botanical conservation（FLORA）
information_points.content:
ENV-FLORA-6SB：At Cerro Toco Bench, the botanical transect survey documented an endemic cushion-plant transect count of 12 plants within the two-hectare construction perimeter buffer.
ENV-FLORA-ETG：At Pampa La Bola Plateau, the botanical transect survey documented an endemic cushion-plant transect count of 18 plants within the two-hectare construction perimeter buffer.
ENV-FLORA-0F5：At Chajnantor North Ridge, the botanical transect survey recorded an endemic cushion-plant transect count of 25 plants within the two-hectare construction perimeter buffer.
